title: Redesign, second hand: choose the new visual world
question: The re-roll assigned the Retrospective. Keep it, take an alternate, take the standing door, or re-roll.

options.label: The Retrospective
options.lineage: museum retrospectives: title wall, painted rooms, object labels with accession numbers and credit lines
options.thesis: Ian's career hung as a museum retrospective: each achievement an object on the wall with its label.
materials: gallery-white walls with one painted feature room per line
options.viewport: The title wall: 'Ian Pascoe, Selected Work 2019–2026' at wall scale, the portrait hung as the exhibition photograph with its own label, the headline as intro wall text, and Email Ian as the visitor-desk sign.
options.path: Read the title wall, walk the rooms (RTX, Spirit-Led Software, University of Rhode Island), read each label's metric and fact, email Ian from the desk.
options.signature: A floor plan of the rooms: the room you are in lights up, and opening an object raises its light while the rest of the room dims.
options.reach: /resume prints as the exhibition checklist of works; 404 is 'Gallery closed for installation'; visitor achievements are stamps in a gallery passport.
options.risk: Museum austerity can turn cold or precious; labels need warmth and the metric must still lead each one.

raised.raise: One hang line: every object centers on the same eye-level line, so the whole show reads as one horizon.
Objects, not cards: each achievement shows its artifact (the certificate, the release log, the team roster) drawn from its real fact.
Everything that looks printed is live, selectable text; no words baked into images.
Rooms are separated by generous voids, so structure comes from space, not rules or boxes.
Every room and object is a deep-linkable named state, and light is the state change.

regions.label: Room 1: objects on the hang line

options.label: The Drawing Sheet
options.lineage: aerospace engineering drawings: title block, revision table, datum callouts
options.thesis: Ian drawn as an engineering sheet whose revision table is his dated record of achievements.
options.viewport: A full sheet: the career drawn as an orthographic assembly, a title block (name, headline, Jacksonville FL, Email Ian), and the revision table listing each dated achievement.
options.path: Read the title block, scan the revision table, open a callout, email Ian.
options.signature: Selecting a revision clouds its change on the drawing in red.
options.reach: /resume is the parts list; 404 is a superseded sheet.
options.risk: Blueprints are a familiar engineer-portfolio trope; it wins only on drafting rigor.

options.label: Night Instrument Panel
options.thesis: Ian's metrics as six calm gauges a hiring manager cross-checks in one sweep.
options.viewport: Two rows of three gauges: test time −75%, deploys −60%, uptime +30%, team 5, mentees 2, users 300+, each needle settling on its value.
options.case: Holds clarity (one truth per gauge, and RTX is aerospace), but the roles and dates have no home on a panel, and the dark ground drifts toward the developer-template look.
options.risk: Metrics without the story; dark ground near the anti-reference.

options.label: City-Pop Airbrush Sleeve
options.thesis: Ian's career as an airbrushed sunset sleeve with chrome script.
options.viewport: A sunset horizon with roles as stops along the shore.
options.case: Declined: mood over record; hiring managers get vibe, not evidence.
options.kept: One hang line holding the whole show.

options.label: Stitched-Leather Shelf
options.thesis: Achievements as loved physical objects on a walnut shelf.
options.viewport: A shelf of books, one per role, pages that curl open.
options.case: Declined: heavy texture slows the scan and reads dated.

options.label: ASCII Live Render
options.thesis: Ian's portrait and record rendered live in glyph density.
options.viewport: An ASCII portrait resolving from periods to at-signs.
options.case: Declined: the exact tech-wants-mono cliché and the dark template PRODUCT.md rejects.
options.kept: Every printed-looking word is live text.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.thesis: Roles as blocks cut from clouds.
options.viewport: Cloud strata with cut blue voids.
options.case: Declined: loses both axes; the metaphor says nothing about Ian's work.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.lineage: theater lighting on a cyclorama wall
options.thesis: Ian's years as a lighting cue from night to day.
options.viewport: Horizon bands brightening as the years advance.
options.case: Declined: atmosphere over facts; the dates hide in the light.
options.kept: Deep-linkable named states; light as the state change.
options.risk: Beautiful, but the record gets lost.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean one-page engineer portfolio, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Name, headline and portrait, then about, experience, projects, contact, at the finish of the portfolios you linked.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other engineer portfolios by design.
